title: Orbit Protocol (Blast) — 4 Compound-fork comptrollers, 21 oToken markets

closed_reasons: All admin/config/yield functions are gated (fork-verified: _setPriceOracle fail-code, _setCloseFactor/_become/_reduceReserves/sweepToken/_blastClaimYield/_setMintPaused revert for a fresh address).
No zero-supply cash-bearing market exists -> no first-depositor donation path (fork-verified, 0 candidates).
Oracle feeds are off-chain-signed with staleness checks (Pyth 3600s, Redstone 86400s, API3 86400s) -> no flash-loan manipulation; stale-window abuse blocked by CF<1.

c3 (the only comptroller with a mispriced collateral feed, RESC->ETH/USD) has mint+borrow paused in every market except DETH and RESC; RESC itself is unobtainable (990k/1M held by team admin, no market).

Liquidations: 4,042 borrowers scanned, 65 underwater, 1 with profitable collateral ($12.50) and all liquidations currently revert StalePrice (Pyth feeds stale ~23 days after the Aug-2026 Hermes API-key migration).
Redstone USDB adapter (c1) requires an authorised updater + signed packages -> c1 USDB market permanently frozen; API3 dAPI for c1 oETHV2 has no name set -> market frozen.

caveats: Blast wind-down: withdrawals via the Blast UI until 2026-10-26, then via L1 bridge contracts; assets remain withdrawable.
Conditional paths depend on a Pyth API key (free/paid registration) to refresh feeds; the protocol's own keepers stopped ~2026-09-20.

Liquidation-profit math uses true market prices (CoinGecko/DefiLlama) as a proxy for refreshed Pyth prices (within ~±1%); DETH DEX liquidity not verified — if DETH is untradable the $12.50 liquidation is also not executable (repay must be in DETH).
RESC has no observable market value (assumed $0).
Some market state reads relied on public RPCs that intermittently return errors; all headline numbers were re-verified via multiple endpoints/Alchemy MCP.
one_liner: External unprivileged attacker can extract ~$0 live from Orbit Protocol (Blast): the $612,954 of cash is supplier-owned, the $22.9k Blast yield is admin-gated, all Pyth oracles are stale (liquidations revert StalePrice; max conditional profit $12.50 for one account), and the RESC->ETH/USD feed mispricing is unexploitable because 990k/1M RESC is held by the team admin and has no market.
